title: The Conflict Crossroads — An Unfolding Story
synopsis: An action-oriented coordinator and a risk-focused analyst both want a strong result. Their conflicting strengths are now dividing the team.

opening.speaker: Sofia Martinez
opening.title: The Meeting Freezes
opening.text: Sofia calls Daniel a roadblock. Daniel fires back that Sofia makes promises nobody can deliver. Both turn to you as colleagues fall silent.
opening.prompt: What do you say while everyone is watching?

choices.text: Interrupt the personal remarks, acknowledge both priorities, and schedule a structured discussion.
